purpose: Exact source identities and assertion disposition for production Rust ownership of the native Qwen decode workspace. No retired C++ fixture or dynamic test DLL is compiled for replay.

completion_boundary.behavior: ggml_backend_graph_compute calls compute_async then ggml_backend_synchronize even on returned error. The generated native lease additionally synchronizes on every exit before calling Rust cache_complete.

retained_obligations.original: First allocation owns exactly one graph; same-window/same-width selection reuses original ID without allocating or releasing.
retained_obligations.replacement: Production safe Cache<Resource> and private C ABI test first allocation and ID reuse with exact allocation/release counters.

retained_obligations.original: All forward windows 512 through 4096 retain one workspace and release obsolete graph before replacement allocation.
retained_obligations.replacement: Same complete ordered schedule on production Rust ABI; every builder entry records live=0, every successful completed selection has live=1 and releases=allocations-1.

retained_obligations.original: A fresh request can return to window256 without stale graph state; changing batch width rebuilds selected graph.
retained_obligations.replacement: Rust key includes exact window class and batch width; ABI tests require new graph IDs/counts on rewind and width change; all16 widths also exercise safe owner reuse.

retained_obligations.original: Failed replacement allocation releases completed scratch, leaves no live graph, and permits new-window and same-window-width retry.
retained_obligations.replacement: Both original failure schedules plus partially allocated builder failure run through real Rust cache ownership and Drop; retry must rebuild from empty cache.

retained_obligations.original: Final teardown releases every graph-local allocation independently of persistent model/KV state.
retained_obligations.replacement: Rust cache Resource Drop owns each noexcept native destroy callback, which runs original graph_free then deletes the graph object. Pipeline initialization failure and teardown clear Rust owner before persistent arena/bridge/KV resources; exact source overlays preserve native graph builder and output/KV work.

retained_obligations.original: Only completed workspace can be released.
retained_obligations.replacement: Active Rust lease rejects every second acquisition without build/eviction. Native RAII lease synchronizes on success, error or exception before cache_complete; cache destruction while a lease remains active aborts the isolated worker instead of releasing in-use memory.

retained_obligations.original: Native cache is exclusively owned by one pipeline.
retained_obligations.replacement: Generated holder deletes copy/move, owns one opaque Rust cache and clears it on destruction. Rust tests retain independent concurrent cache instances and verify no cross-release.

qualification_boundary: Focused tests and actual pinned modified-translation-unit compilation must pass before deleting the old control. Full hosted Qwen owning-crate build/link, actual-model speech output, cancellation/lifecycle/resource/quality and distribution remain pending. Native GGML graph construction/compute and primitive destroy callbacks are still external C++ dependencies; moving ownership to Rust does not retire those inference engines.

prior_native_fixture_validation.scope: Historical passing native graph-lifetime DLL using the former Rust selection exports; this port does not relabel that record as a new native run. New ownership checks use the production Rust cache and audited resource callbacks.
